description: This file contains Kotlin code defining composable functions for performance monitoring and jank tracking in an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes functions to retrieve performance metrics, track jank during scrolling, and manage side effects related to performance measurement.

methods.name: rememberMetricsStateHolder
methods.description: Retrieves and remembers a PerformanceMetricsState.Holder for the current LocalView, updating if the view changes.

methods.name: TrackJank
methods.description: Tracks jank by launching a suspend reportMetric function whenever specified keys change.

methods.name: TrackDisposableJank
methods.description: Tracks jank with cleanup, re-launching if keys change, using DisposableEffect.

methods.name: TrackScrollJank
methods.description: Tracks jank during scrolling of a ScrollableState, updating performance state accordingly.
